coarse_context.tile_resolution_note: nominal 1 km at equator multiplied by stride

mcd_metadata.grid_resolution: MCD native GCM grid; typically 5.625 deg longitude x 3.75 deg latitude

semantic_metadata.dune_hit: dune_hit=1 means a cell intersects an included MGD3 dune polygon. 0 means no included polygon hit; it does not prove dune absence outside mapped product coverage.
semantic_metadata.dune_distance_km: Minimum planar distance from each cell center to the union of included MGD3 dune polygons after projection into a local Mars spherical azimuthal-equidistant CRS; accurate for regional windows, approximate for very broad windows. A value of 0 means inside/on a mapped polygon. Product coverage remains incomplete, so distance is to mapped dunes only.
semantic_metadata.crater_edge_distance_km: Spherical center distance minus half source diameter, clamped to zero; not a measured rim polygon.
semantic_metadata.mcd_spatial_resolution: MCD variables are interpolated from the native GCM grid and repeated at terrain-cell locations; they are not independent 1 km measurements.

usage.vision_model: Experimental 7-channel U-Net: CTX image, elevation, slope, aspect encoded east/north, plane-residual roughness, and 3x3 relief. Training labels are weak DTM-derived slope/roughness proxies; not human-verified. It does not ingest the coarse context fields as 20 m values.
usage.A_star: Use local elevation/slope/aspect/roughness at DTM scale; sample vector/TES/MCD context at its native nominal 1 km scale.
usage.resolution_warning: The high-resolution DTM does not make the coarse TES, MCD, geology, crater, or dune fields 20 m measurements.
usage.coarse_context_model_use: All source global feature tile columns are preserved in the separate nominal 1 km context Parquet. A* samples mapped dune/crater semantics; TES, MCD, geology and other fields remain context and are not calibrated mobility costs.
usage.A_star_vision: Optional JSON flag use_vision_model=true adds the experimental probability raster as a soft cost only; default remains off. Predictions never hard-block cells.
